problem: The first structural cross-browser production audit returned 73 failures across 247 public routes, 592 render checks and 24 interactions.
root_cause: The failures collapsed into shared causes: late desktop language-control insertion changed header geometry after first paint; the mobile menu button changed markup and dimensions after JavaScript; the critical matrix used /platform instead of canonical /product; interaction probes targeted superseded or hidden controls.
decision: Reserve final header geometry in canonical HTML/CSS, use canonical product route, test the real mobile/desktop/language controls, and capture CLS source nodes for any remaining layout shift.
prevention: Desktop language control is present in canonical header HTML before first paint.
Mobile Menu control starts with its final 72x44 pill geometry and final child markup.
PR assurance targets the exact Netlify candidate preview; scheduled assurance targets production.
CLS evidence includes source selectors and rectangles.
Canonical screenshot matrix uses /product; /platform remains redirect-contract coverage only.
